A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Mono-InternVL and contain 24 readable pages, including matching main sections and Appendix A.1–A.4. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of the equations, tables, figures and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark evaluations, inference-speed measurements and ablations in Tables 2–6 and Appendix A.3, plus model-generated examples in Appendix A.4.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark, efficiency, ablation and qualitative results, including those in Appendices A.3–A.4.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same visual tokenizer, static visual/textual expert routing, progressive EViP stages, training objective and instruction-tuning procedure.

E1.justification: Training coverage in Tables 1 and 7, the 16 multimodal and four NLP benchmarks, pre-training evaluations and appendix scenarios remain unchanged. The SEED Image citation replacement does not change the evaluated benchmark.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in Tables 2–4 and 6 is unchanged, including Emu3, EVE, Chameleon and InternVL-1.5. The ablation controls also remain identical.

E3.justification: Splits, metrics, model configurations and training schedules are unchanged. Table 6 still specifies an A100, LMDeploy's PyTorch backend, concurrency 16 and 120 output tokens; removing the future Turbomind suggestion does not revise this measured setup.

E4.justification: The tuning ablations in Table 5, data-scaling analyses in Figures 4 and 6, attention-freezing ablation in Table 9, attention maps in Figure 5 and Appendix A.4 examples are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate and scaling-curve reporting. Neither reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: Corresponding scores, curves, attention maps and appendix responses match. Table 2 retains OCRBench scores of 767 for Mono-InternVL and 687 for Emu3; Table 6 retains the same latency and throughput measurements.

T1.justification: Equations 1–6 defining embeddings, generation, expert routing and the training objective are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same architectural and EViP contributions, language-knowledge preservation claim, benchmark superiority claims and up-to-67% first-token-latency reduction.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning language retention, data scaling, attention patterns and high-resolution limitations remain unchanged. Removing 'Turbomind backend or' leaves the same general qualification that further optimization may improve efficiency.

D1.justification: v2 directs code/model access to the Hugging Face Mono-InternVL-2B page. v3 replaces that pointer with the GitHub Mono-InternVL repository and adds a separate Code line on page 1. Implementation and hyperparameter disclosures otherwise match.

R1.justification: Section 4.1 replaces the SEED Image citation to Ge et al.'s 'Making LLaMA SEE and draw with SEED tokenizer' (v2 reference 31) with Li et al.'s 'SEED-Bench: Benchmarking multimodal LLMs with generative comprehension' (v3 reference 48). Broader research positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: Edits are limited to the added Code line, resource pointer, version stamp and removal of the Turbomind example in Section 4.3. The narrative, section order and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 reflows the first page around the added Code line, slightly adjusts table rules and spacing on pages 8–9, and reflows bibliography entries. No figures, tables or appendix example panels are added or removed.

improvement.justification: The corrected SEED Image attribution and prominent code-repository pointer modestly improve citation accuracy and resource navigation. The method, experimental evidence and conclusions remain unchanged, so the overall benefit is limited to documentation; actual repository availability is not established by the PDFs.
